notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilites.
Repeat step 1 until Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-base action due to having zero or less toughness.
Othelm triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
